public_rationale: On the tentative reading signaled by “appear,” the claim is supported. November reporting described a pretraining plateau and disappointing results based on several insiders; December remarks identified limits to the supply of training data. limitations: The outcome depends on reading the claim as tentative corroboration from insider testimony.

The December evidence repeats Sutskever's view rather than adding an independent named witness.

from_speaker: would eventually start to run out

our_interpretation: This assesses the retrospective claim about November–December 2024, not the original undated forecast.
Pure scaling means increasing pretraining data, model size and computing resources without relying on a different method of improving performance.
Start to run out ordinarily means diminishing gains or practical limits, rather than all progress stopping.
Appear to have been confirmed is read as tentative corroboration from insider testimony. It does not require scientific proof of a permanent ceiling or unanimous agreement.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous reporting and insider statements in November–December 2024 provide credible, multiple-source corroboration of diminishing gains or practical limits from scaling pretraining alone.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The attributed statements do not concern pretraining limits, are materially misrepresented, or reliable contemporaneous evidence establishes that the reported corroboration did not occur.
